language.title: LANGUAGE
language.hint: Changes the game's menus and text. Case files and the trial itself stay in English for now.

difficulty.heading: DIFFICULTY
difficulty.note: Changes the judge and prosecution — not the case. Applies to every trial.

easy.label: Easy
easy.description: The judge explains rulings and gives you room to find your footing. The prosecution argues plainly, without tricks.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Standard courtroom conduct. The judge is even-handed, and the prosecution argues competently and pushes back when warranted.

hard.label: Hard
hard.description: The judge holds you strictly to procedure and courtroom decorum. The prosecution is sharp, aggressive, and looks for every opening.

nickname.heading: NICKNAME
nickname.help: Shown on leaderboards and in court. Your email is never shown. You appear as <name>{{name}}</name>.
nickname.errTaken: That username is taken. Try another one.

avatar.heading: AVATAR
avatar.label: Your avatar
avatar.help: {{rank}}. Your outfit gets better as you win cases.

account.heading: ACCOUNT
account.guestWarning: You're playing as a guest. Signing out will permanently lose your progress and wins.

landing.challengedYou: A friend challenged you — you'd play the {{role}}.

home.tagline1: HOW GOOD A LAWYER ARE YOU?
home.taglineFull: How Good a Lawyer Are You? Prove It in Court
home.step1: Pick a case and your side

learn.intro: Play a full trial, from case file to verdict.
learn.item1: Review the evidence and witnesses — the loophole is in there somewhere.
learn.item2: Prosecute or defend. Same case, completely different game depending on your side.
learn.item3: Object, examine witnesses, and convince the court before your opponent does.
learn.fullCourtroom: A real judge rules on your objections, witnesses answer based on their actual testimony, and opposing counsel argues back — all reactive to what you actually say.
learn.realOpponent: Open a live challenge, pick your side, and argue the case against another player, just the two of you.
learn.ownCase: Build a custom case with your own evidence and witnesses.
